systems.system: National Backbone Fiber Optic Cable Network and Communication Service Project
systems.owner: Government of Niger; SONITEL responsible for loan repayment
systems.tiers: more than 2,275 km on the Niamey-Tillabéry, Zinder-Diffa and Agadez-Tahoua sections, built 2015 to early 2017 with e-government services in scope; no local government office said to be on it

note: AidData's record of the 2014 China Eximbank loan for the national fibre backbone; 'handed over to the local authorities' means the Nigerien authorities receiving the works, and no commune or other local government office is said to be connected.
